title: Restoranda: menyu va hisob
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilidagi menyuni o‘qiysiz, boshlang‘ich va asosiy taomni maxsus iltimoslar bilan buyurtma qilasiz, muloyim shikoyat qilasiz va hisobni to‘lash va choychaqa odatlariga mos gapirasiz.

vocab.uz: duxovkada pishgan (non, kartoshka) / duxovkada pishgan (go‘sht) / bug‘da pishgan

scenes.title: Restoranga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda bayramlar va urf-odatlar haqida gapirdik, to‘y va Navro‘zni ingliz tilida tasvirlashni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa juda amaliy mavzu: restoran. Menyuni o‘qish, taom va ichimlik buyurtma qilish, biror narsa yoqmasa muloyim shikoyat qilish va oxirida hisobni to‘lashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Today we are going to a restaurant. We will read a menu, order food, make a polite complaint and pay the bill.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! Bugun restoranga boramiz. Menyuni o‘qiymiz, taom buyurtma qilamiz, muloyim shikoyat qilamiz va hisobni to‘laymiz.

scenes.title: Menyuning qismlari

examples.t: I'd like soup for my starter.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilidagi menyu odatda bir necha qismga bo‘linadi. Birinchisi “starter” — asosiy taomdan oldin yeyiladigan yengil taom, masalan, salat yoki sho‘rva. Amerikada buni “appetizer” deyishadi. Keyin “main course” — asosiy taom. So‘ng “dessert” — shirinlik. Alohida “side dishes” bo‘limi ham bo‘ladi, bu garnir: kartoshka fri, guruch, sabzavot.
scenes.say: Starters, main courses, desserts, side dishes and drinks. In America, a starter is an appetizer.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlang‘ich taomlar, asosiy taomlar, shirinliklar, garnirlar va ichimliklar. Amerikada starter — appetizer deyiladi.

scenes.title: Menyudagi so‘zlar
scenes.say_native: Menyudagi eng ko‘p uchraydigan so‘zlar bilan tanishamiz. Go‘sht turlari: “chicken” — tovuq, “beef” — mol go‘shti, “lamb” — qo‘y go‘shti, “fish” — baliq. E’tibor bering, inglizlar hayvon va uning go‘shtini ko‘pincha boshqa so‘z bilan aytadi: “cow” — sigir, lekin go‘shti “beef”. Garnirlar: “rice” — guruch, “vegetables” — sabzavotlar, “chips” — kartoshka fri.
scenes.say: Chicken, beef, lamb, fish. Rice, chips, vegetables. Cake, ice cream, fruit.
scenes.say_uz: Tovuq, mol go‘shti, qo‘y go‘shti, baliq. Guruch, kartoshka fri, sabzavotlar. Tort, muzqaymoq, meva.

scenes.title: Dessert va desert
board: ✗ I'd like a desert.  ✓ I'd like a dessert.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik adashadigan juft so‘z bor. “Dessert”, ikkita “s” bilan, shirinlik degani va urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: /dɪˈzɜːt/. “Desert”, bitta “s” bilan, cho‘l degani va urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: /ˈdezət/. Agar ofitsiantga “desert” desangiz, u cho‘l so‘rayapsiz deb hazil qilishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Dessert. Dessert. Could I see the dessert menu, please?
scenes.say_uz: Shirinlik. Shirinlik. Shirinliklar menyusini ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Pishirish usullari
scenes.say_native: Menyuda taom nomi oldida ko‘pincha pishirish usuli yoziladi. “Fried” — yog‘da qovurilgan, masalan, “fried eggs”. “Boiled” — suvda qaynatilgan: “boiled potatoes”. “Grilled” — cho‘g‘ yoki panjara ustida pishirilgan: “grilled chicken”. “Baked” va “roasted” ikkalasi ham duxovkada pishirilgan degani.
scenes.say: Fried eggs. Boiled potatoes. Grilled chicken. Baked potatoes. Roast lamb.
scenes.say_uz: Qovurilgan tuxum. Qaynatilgan kartoshka. Panjarada pishgan tovuq. Duxovkada pishgan kartoshka. Duxovkada pishgan qo‘y go‘shti.

scenes.title: Yana usullar va steyk

examples.t: How would you like your steak?

scenes.say_native: Yana bir nechta muhim so‘z. “Steamed” — bug‘da pishirilgan, masalan, “steamed vegetables”. “Stewed” — sekin olovda suyuqlikda dimlangan, o‘zbekcha dimlamaga yaqin. “Raw” — xom. Agar steyk buyurtma qilsangiz, ofitsiant albatta “How would you like your steak?” deb so‘raydi.
scenes.say: How would you like your steak? Well done, please. Medium, please.
scenes.say_uz: Steykingiz qanday bo‘lsin? To‘liq pishgan bo‘lsin, iltimos. O‘rtacha, iltimos.

scenes.title: O‘zbek taomlarini tushuntirish
board: plov — a rice dish with lamb and carrots
shashlik — grilled meat on a stick
somsa — a baked pastry with meat
scenes.say_native: Chet ellik mehmonni o‘zbek restoraniga olib borsangiz, taomlarni tushuntira olishingiz kerak. Bunda pishirish usuli so‘zlari juda asqotadi. Palov — “a rice dish with lamb and carrots”. Manti — “steamed dumplings”, ya’ni bug‘da pishgan chuchvara. Shashlik — “grilled meat on a stick”.
scenes.say: Manti are steamed dumplings with meat and onion. Shashlik is grilled meat on a stick.
scenes.say_uz: Manti — go‘sht va piyozli bug‘da pishgan chuchvara. Shashlik — sixga tortib cho‘g‘da pishirilgan go‘sht.

scenes.title: Fry emas, fried
board: fry → fried, boil → boiled, bake → baked
scenes.say_native: Taomni tasvirlaganda fe’lning o‘zini emas, “-ed” shaklini ishlatamiz, chunki bu sifat vazifasini bajaradi: “fried chicken” — qovurilgan tovuq. “Fry chicken” desangiz, bu buyruqqa o‘xshaydi: tovuqni qovuring. O‘zbekchada ham “qovur” emas, “qovurilgan” deymiz, xuddi shunday.
scenes.say: Fried chicken. Boiled eggs. Baked fish. Grilled vegetables.
scenes.say_uz: Qovurilgan tovuq. Qaynatilgan tuxum. Duxovkada pishgan baliq. Panjarada pishgan sabzavotlar.

scenes.title: Taomni tasvirlang
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz ayting. Doskada to‘rtta mahsulot va pishirish usuli bor. Har biri uchun ingliz tilida ikki so‘zli taom nomini tuzing. Fe’lning “-ed” shaklini unutmang va oxiridagi tovushni to‘g‘ri talaffuz qiling. Baland ovozda ayting. Bu so‘zlar menyuda doim taom nomidan oldin turadi, shuning uchun ularni tez taniy olish juda muhim.
scenes.say: Eggs, boiled? Fish, baked? Vegetables, steamed? Lamb, grilled?
scenes.say_uz: Tuxum, qaynatilgan? Baliq, duxovkada? Sabzavot, bug‘da? Qo‘y go‘shti, cho‘g‘da?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “boiled eggs”, “baked fish”, “steamed vegetables”, “grilled lamb”. Agar “boil eggs” yoki “bake fish” degan bo‘lsangiz, yana bir marta “-ed” qo‘shib takrorlang. Ikkinchi javobda “roast fish” ham deyish mumkin, lekin baliq uchun “baked” ko‘proq ishlatiladi. Qo‘y go‘shti uchun yana bir variant: “lamb kebab” yoki “grilled lamb kebab”.
scenes.say: Boiled eggs. Baked fish. Steamed vegetables. Grilled lamb.
scenes.say_uz: Qaynatilgan tuxum. Duxovkada pishgan baliq. Bug‘da pishgan sabzavotlar. Cho‘g‘da pishgan qo‘y go‘shti.

scenes.title: Ta’mni tasvirlash
board: salty / sweet / sour — sho‘r / shirin / nordon
scenes.say_native: Taomning ta’mini ham aytib bera olish kerak. “Spicy” — qalampirli, achchiq. “Salty” — sho‘r, “sweet” — shirin, “sour” — nordon. “Fresh” — yangi, yangi uzilgan. “Delicious” — juda mazali. O‘zbekchada “achchiq” so‘zi ham qalampir ta’mi, ham choyning achchiqligi uchun ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Is this dish spicy? The soup is delicious. The salad is very fresh.
scenes.say_uz: Bu taom achchiqmi? Sho‘rva juda mazali. Salat juda yangi.

scenes.title: Restoranga kirish
board: I've booked a table for 7 o'clock.
Can we sit by the window?
scenes.say_native: Endi ikkinchi katta qism: buyurtma berish. Hammasi eshikdan boshlanadi. Kirganingizda “A table for two, please” — ikki kishilik stol, iltimos, deysiz. Agar oldindan joy band qilgan bo‘lsangiz: “I’ve booked a table for seven o’clock”. Xodim sizdan “Do you have a reservation?” — joy band qilganmisiz? deb so‘rashi mumkin.
scenes.say: Good evening. A table for two, please. Do you have a reservation? Yes, I've booked a table for seven o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kech. Ikki kishilik stol, iltimos. Joy band qilganmisiz? Ha, soat yettiga stol band qilganman.

scenes.title: Buyurtma iboralari
board: Are you ready to order? — Buyurtma berasizmi?
scenes.say_native: Ofitsiant kelib “Are you ready to order?” deydi. Siz uch xil ibora bilan buyurtma bera olasiz. “I’d like the chicken soup” — tovuq sho‘rvasini xohlardim. “I’ll have the fish” — men baliq olaman. “Could I have a salad, please?” — salat olsam bo‘ladimi? Uchalasi ham muloyim. Ofitsiant “Anything to drink?” deb ichimlik so‘raydi.
scenes.say: Are you ready to order? Yes. I'd like the chicken soup, please. And I'll have the grilled fish.
scenes.say_uz: Buyurtma berasizmi? Ha. Tovuq sho‘rvasini olmoqchiman, iltimos. Va men panjarada pishgan baliqni olaman.

scenes.title: Taomlarni ketma-ket buyurtma qilish
board: For my main course, I'll have ...
scenes.say_native: Bir nechta taom buyurtma qilganda “for” so‘zidan foydalaning: “For my starter, I’d like the tomato soup. For my main course, I’ll have the roast lamb.” Ichimlik uchun: “And to drink, a glass of water, please.” Nima tanlashni bilmasangiz, ofitsiantdan maslahat so‘rang: “What do you recommend?” — nimani tavsiya qilasiz? Yoki “What’s today’s special?”
scenes.say: For my starter, I'd like the tomato soup. For my main course, I'll have the roast lamb. And to drink, a glass of water, please.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlang‘ich taomga pomidor sho‘rvasini olaman. Asosiy taomga duxovkada pishgan qo‘y go‘shtini olaman. Ichimlikka bir stakan suv, iltimos.

scenes.title: Give me — qo‘pol eshitiladi
board: ✗ Give me soup.  ✗ I want soup.
✓ Could I have the soup, please?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “Menga sho‘rva bering” deyish mutlaqo normal. Lekin uni so‘zma-so‘z “Give me soup” deb tarjima qilsangiz, ingliz quloqqa buyruq kabi qo‘pol eshitiladi. “I want soup” ham bola gapiga o‘xshaydi. Restoranda doim “I’d like”, “I’ll have” yoki “Could I have” ishlating va oxirida “please” qo‘shing.
scenes.say: Not: Give me soup. Say: I'd like the soup, please. Could I have the soup, please?
scenes.say_uz: “Menga sho‘rva bering” emas. Ayting: Sho‘rvani olmoqchiman, iltimos. Sho‘rva olsam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Maxsus iltimoslar
board: Could I have it without onions?
Can I have the sauce on the side?
Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
scenes.say_native: Ba’zan taomni o‘zingizga moslab buyurtma qilishingiz kerak. “Without” — -siz: “Could I have it without onions?” — piyozsiz bo‘lsa bo‘ladimi? “With extra” — qo‘shimcha: “with extra cheese”. “On the side” — alohida: “Can I have the sauce on the side?” — sousni alohida bersangiz. Allergiya bo‘lsa: “I’m allergic to nuts” — yong‘oqqa allergiyam bor.
scenes.say: Could I have the burger without onions, please? And can I have the sauce on the side? I'm allergic to nuts.
scenes.say_uz: Burgerni piyozsiz bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Sousni esa alohida bersangiz. Menda yong‘oqqa allergiya bor.

scenes.title: Savol berish
board: What's in the ...? — ... ichida nima bor?
scenes.say_native: Menyuda tushunarsiz taom bo‘lsa, so‘rashdan uyalmang. “What’s in the house salad?” — uy salatida nima bor? “Is it spicy?” — achchiqmi? “Is it very big?” yoki “How big is the portion?” — porsiya qanchalik katta? Bolalar bilan bo‘lsangiz: “Do you have a children’s menu?” — bolalar menyusi bormi?
scenes.say: Excuse me, what's in the house salad? Is it spicy? Do you have a children's menu?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, uy salatida nima bor? U achchiqmi? Bolalar menyusi bormi?

scenes.title: Allergic va without
board: ✗ I am allergy to nuts.  ✓ I'm allergic to nuts.
✗ Without sugar make.  ✓ Without sugar, please.
scenes.say_native: Ikki keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi: “I am allergy”. “Allergy” — ot, ya’ni allergiya. Gapda sifat kerak: “I’m allergic to nuts”, yoki ot bilan: “I have a nut allergy”. Predlog ham muhim: “allergic to”, “from” emas. Ikkinchisi: so‘z tartibi. O‘zbekcha “Shakarsiz qiling” degan gapni “Without sugar make” deb tuzmang.
scenes.say: I'm allergic to nuts. I have a nut allergy. A coffee without sugar, please.
scenes.say_uz: Menda yong‘oqqa allergiya bor. Menda yong‘oq allergiyasi bor. Shakarsiz qahva, iltimos.

scenes.title: Iltimos qiling
scenes.say_native: Navbat sizga. To‘rtta vaziyat. Birinchi: salatni piyozsiz so‘rang. Ikkinchi: ofitsiantga yong‘oqqa allergiyangiz borligini ayting. Uchinchi: vegetarian taomlar bormi, deb so‘rang. To‘rtinchi: sousni alohida berishlarini so‘rang. Har bir gapni muloyim qilib, “please” bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Number one. Number two. Number three. Number four. Your turn.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi. Ikkinchi. Uchinchi. To‘rtinchi. Navbat sizga.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Could I have the salad without onions, please?
3) Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
4) Can I have the sauce on the side, please?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “Could I have the salad without onions, please?” Ikkinchi: “I’m allergic to nuts” yoki “I have a nut allergy”. Uchinchi: “Do you have any vegetarian dishes?” To‘rtinchi: “Can I have the sauce on the side, please?” Agar “Could” o‘rniga “Can” ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz ham to‘g‘ri, faqat “Could” biroz muloyimroq.
scenes.say: Could I have the salad without onions, please? I'm allergic to nuts. Do you have any vegetarian dishes? Can I have the sauce on the side, please?
scenes.say_uz: Salatni piyozsiz bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Menda yong‘oqqa allergiya bor. Vegetarian taomlaringiz bormi? Sousni alohida bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
board: a cup of tea → /ə kʌp‿əv tiː/
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida kichik yordamchi so‘zlar gapda zaif aytiladi va qo‘shni so‘zga ulanib ketadi. “Can I have” gapida “can” to‘liq “ken” emas, qisqa /kən/ bo‘lib eshitiladi. “A cup of tea” da “of” deyarli /əv/, ba’zan shunchaki /ə/ bo‘lib qoladi. “Fish and chips” da “and” /ən/ bo‘lib, “fish’n chips” ga o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: Can I have a cup of tea? Could I have fish and chips, please?
scenes.say_uz: Bir chashka choy olsam bo‘ladimi? Baliq va kartoshka fri bersangiz, iltimos?

scenes.title: Ulab takrorlang
board: Can I have a cup of tea?
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Kichik so‘zlarni zaif va tez ayting, asosiy urg‘uni esa “tea”, “bill”, “chips”, “water” so‘zlariga bering. Har bir gapni bir nafasda, ulab ayting. Shoshilmang, lekin to‘xtab ham qolmang. Avval sekin, keyin odatiy tezlikda ayting. Ofitsiant shovqinli zalda ham sizni tushunishi uchun ana shu ritm juda yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Can I have a cup of tea? Could I have the bill? Fish and chips, please. A glass of water, please.
scenes.say_uz: Bir chashka choy olsam bo‘ladimi? Hisobni bersangiz? Baliq va kartoshka fri, iltimos. Bir stakan suv, iltimos.

scenes.title: Urg‘u qayerda edi
board: can I HAVE a cup of TEA
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. O‘zingizni tekshiring: urg‘u ma’no beruvchi so‘zlarga tushdi. “A GLASS of WAter” da “a” va “of” juda yengil, deyarli eshitilmaydi. “Water” so‘zida Britaniya talaffuzida “r” aytilmaydi: /ˈwɔːtə/. Amerikada esa “r” eshitiladi va o‘rtadagi “t” ko‘pincha yumshoq “d” ga o‘xshab qoladi. Ikkalasini ham tushunasiz, o‘zingiz esa britancha variantni ishlatavering.
scenes.say: A glass of water, please. Water. Water.
scenes.say_uz: Bir stakan suv, iltimos. Suv. Suv.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: buyurtma
board: What does the woman want without?
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Er-xotin restoranga kelgan. Ofitsiant buyurtma qabul qiladi. Tinglayotganda uchta narsaga e’tibor bering: kim qo‘y go‘shtini buyurtma qiladi, ayol nimani olib tashlashni so‘raydi va ular nima ichadi. Doskadagi savollarni yodda tuting.
scenes.say: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Man: Yes. For my starter, I'd like the mushroom soup. And for my main course, I'll have the roast lamb. Waiter: How would you like it? Man: Well done, please. Woman: Could I have the chicken salad without onions, please? Waiter: Of course. Anything to drink? Woman: Two glasses of apple juice, please.
scenes.say_uz: Ofitsiant: Buyurtma berasizmi? Erkak: Ha. Boshlang‘ich taomga qo‘ziqorin sho‘rvasini olaman. Asosiy taomga duxovkada pishgan qo‘y go‘shtini olaman. Ofitsiant: Qanday pishgan bo‘lsin? Erkak: To‘liq pishgan, iltimos. Ayol: Tovuqli salatni piyozsiz bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Ofitsiant: Albatta. Ichimlikka nima olasiz? Ayol: Ikki stakan olma sharbati, iltimos.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 2) How does he want the lamb?
3) What does the woman want without onions?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Erkakning boshlang‘ich taomi nima? U qo‘y go‘shtini qanday pishgan holda xohlaydi? Ayol qaysi taomni piyozsiz so‘radi? Ular nima ichishadi? Javoblarni ingliz tilida, qisqa qilib ayting. To‘liq gap shart emas, ikki-uch so‘z yetarli. Agar biror javobni eslay olmasangiz, dialogni yana bir marta tinglab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: What is the man's starter? How does he want the lamb? What does the woman want without onions? What do they drink?
scenes.say_uz: Erkakning boshlang‘ich taomi nima? U qo‘y go‘shtini qanday xohlaydi? Ayol nimani piyozsiz xohlaydi? Ular nima ichishadi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “mushroom soup” — qo‘ziqorin sho‘rvasi. Ikkinchi: “well done” — to‘liq pishgan. Uchinchi: “the chicken salad” — tovuqli salat. To‘rtinchi: “two glasses of apple juice” — ikki stakan olma sharbati. Dialogdagi iboralarga yana bir bor e’tibor bering: “For my starter”, “I’ll have”, “Could I have ... without ...”
scenes.say: The man's starter is mushroom soup. He wants the lamb well done. The woman wants the chicken salad without onions. They drink apple juice.
scenes.say_uz: Erkakning boshlang‘ich taomi — qo‘ziqorin sho‘rvasi. U qo‘y go‘shtini to‘liq pishgan holda xohlaydi. Ayol tovuqli salatni piyozsiz xohlaydi. Ular olma sharbati ichishadi.

scenes.title: Muloyim shikoyat: tuzilma
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: muloyim shikoyat qilish. Ingliz madaniyatida shikoyat ham odob bilan aytiladi va uch qismdan iborat bo‘ladi. Avval e’tiborni tortasiz: “Excuse me”. Keyin muammoni yumshatib aytasiz: “I’m afraid my soup is cold”. Bu yerda “I’m afraid” qo‘rqaman degani emas, balki “afsuski” ma’nosida. So‘ng yechim so‘raysiz: “Could you warm it up, please?”
scenes.say: Excuse me. I'm afraid my soup is cold. Could you warm it up, please?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz. Afsuski, sho‘rvam sovuq. Uni isitib bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Ko‘p uchraydigan muammolar
scenes.say_native: Restoranda bo‘ladigan odatiy muammolar. Boshqa taom keltirishdi: “This isn’t what I ordered” — men buni buyurtma qilmagan edim. Go‘sht haddan tashqari pishib ketgan: “overcooked”, chala pishgan: “undercooked”. Vilka iflos: “My fork is dirty”. Uzoq kutib qoldingiz: “We’ve been waiting for forty minutes”.
scenes.say: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered. I ordered the fish, not the chicken.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, men buni buyurtma qilmagan edim. Men tovuq emas, baliq buyurtma qilgandim.

scenes.title: Yechim so‘rash
board: Could you take it back, please?
Could you check on our order?
Waiter: I'm so sorry. I'll change it right away.
scenes.say_native: Muammoni aytgach, aniq yechim so‘rang. “Could you take it back, please?” — olib ketsangiz. “Could I have another one?” — boshqasini bersangiz. “Could you check on our order?” — buyurtmamiz nima bo‘lganini bilib bersangiz. Odatda ofitsiant shunday javob beradi: “I’m so sorry. I’ll change it right away” — juda uzr, hozir almashtiraman.
scenes.say: I'm so sorry about that. I'll change it right away. Thank you, that's very kind.
scenes.say_uz: Buning uchun juda uzr. Hozir almashtiraman. Rahmat, juda iltifot qildingiz.

scenes.title: Qo‘pol va muloyim shikoyat
board: ✗ This food is bad! Change it!
✓ Excuse me, I'm afraid this is a bit cold.
scenes.say_native: Shikoyatdagi eng katta xato — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri va baland ovozda gapirish: “This food is bad! Change it!” Hatto haq bo‘lsangiz ham, bunday gap janjal kabi eshitiladi. Ingliz tilida yumshatuvchi so‘zlar ishlatiladi: “a bit” — biroz, “I’m afraid” — afsuski, “Could you” — qila olasizmi.
scenes.say: Not: Change it! Say: Excuse me, I'm afraid this is a bit cold. Could you change it, please?
scenes.say_uz: “Almashtiring!” demang. Ayting: Kechirasiz, afsuski, bu biroz sovuq. Uni almashtirib bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Madaniy farq
board: EN: Softer: “I'm afraid the soup is a bit cold.”
a bit, I'm afraid, Could you ...?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek restoranlarida mijoz ko‘pincha to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytadi: “Sho‘rva sovib qolibdi, isitib bering”, va bu qo‘pol hisoblanmaydi. Ingliz tilida esa bunday gap so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilinsa, keskin eshitiladi. Shuning uchun inglizlar kichik so‘zlarni qo‘shib, gapni yumshatadi.
scenes.say: I'm afraid the soup is a bit cold. Could you warm it up for me, please?
scenes.say_uz: Afsuski, sho‘rva biroz sovuq. Menga isitib bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Muloyim shikoyat qiling
board: 2) Siz suv so‘ragansiz, lekin sharbat keltirishdi.
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Har birida uch qismli tuzilmani ishlating: “Excuse me”, muammo, yechim. Birinchi: steykingiz chala pishgan. Ikkinchi: siz suv so‘ragansiz, lekin sharbat olib kelishdi. Uchinchi: yarim soatdan beri taomingizni kutyapsiz. Muloyim ohangda ayting.
scenes.say: Situation one. Situation two. Situation three. Be polite!
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi vaziyat. Ikkinchi vaziyat. Uchinchi vaziyat. Muloyim bo‘ling!

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) Excuse me, I'm afraid my steak is undercooked. Could you take it back, please?
2) I'm sorry, but I ordered water, not juice.
3) Excuse me, we've been waiting for 30 minutes. Could you check on our order?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “Excuse me, I’m afraid my steak is undercooked. Could you take it back, please?” Ikkinchi: “I’m sorry, but I ordered water, not juice.” Uchinchi: “Excuse me, we’ve been waiting for thirty minutes. Could you check on our order, please?” So‘zlaringiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, asosiysi, uchala qism ham bor va buyruq shakli yo‘q.
scenes.say: Excuse me, I'm afraid my steak is undercooked. Could you take it back, please? I'm sorry, but I ordered water, not juice.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, afsuski, steykim chala pishgan. Uni olib ketsangiz bo‘ladimi? Uzr, lekin men sharbat emas, suv buyurtma qilgandim.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: shikoyat
board: Listen: What is wrong with the pasta?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Mijoz taomdan norozi. Tinglang: makaron bilan qanday muammo bor, mijoz nima so‘raydi va ofitsiant qo‘shimcha ravishda nima taklif qiladi. Mijozning gaplari qanchalik muloyim ekaniga ham e’tibor bering. U ovozini ko‘tarmaydi, lekin muammoni aniq aytadi. Bu o‘rganishga arziydigan uslub.
scenes.say: Customer: Excuse me. Waiter: Yes, madam? Customer: I'm sorry, but I'm afraid my pasta is a bit cold. And it's very salty. Waiter: Oh, I'm so sorry. Would you like a new one? Customer: Yes, please. Could I have it with less salt? Waiter: Of course. And the dessert is free tonight, to say sorry. Customer: Oh, that's very kind. Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz: Kechirasiz. Ofitsiant: Ha, xonim? Mijoz: Uzr, lekin afsuski, makaronim biroz sovuq. Yana juda sho‘r. Ofitsiant: Oh, juda uzr. Yangisini olib kelaymi? Mijoz: Ha, iltimos. Tuzi kamroq bo‘lsa bo‘ladimi? Ofitsiant: Albatta. Va kechirim sifatida bugun shirinlik bepul. Mijoz: Oh, juda iltifot. Rahmat.

scenes.title: Tushundingizmi?
board: 2) What does the customer ask for?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Makaron bilan qanday ikki muammo bor edi? Mijoz nima so‘radi? Ofitsiant nimani bepul qildi? Javob berishdan oldin mijoz qaysi yumshatuvchi so‘zlarni ishlatganini ham eslab ko‘ring. Ular bizga bugungi darsning eng muhim qismi: shikoyatni odob bilan aytishni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: What are the two problems? What does the customer ask for? What is free?
scenes.say_uz: Ikki muammo nima? Mijoz nima so‘raydi? Nima bepul?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) a new one, with less salt
Softeners: I'm sorry, but / I'm afraid / a bit
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: makaron sovuq va juda sho‘r edi. Ikkinchi: mijoz yangisini, tuzi kamroq qilib so‘radi: “with less salt”. Uchinchi: shirinlik bepul bo‘ldi. Yumshatuvchi so‘zlar: “I’m sorry, but”, “I’m afraid”, “a bit”. Ofitsiant ham juda muloyim edi: “Would you like a new one?” — yangisini xohlaysizmi? Muloyim shikoyat ko‘pincha shunday yaxshi natija beradi.
scenes.say: The pasta was cold and very salty. She asked for a new one with less salt. The dessert was free.
scenes.say_uz: Makaron sovuq va juda sho‘r edi. U tuzi kamroq yangisini so‘radi. Shirinlik bepul bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Hisobni so‘rash
board: Could we have the bill, please? (UK)
Could we have the check, please? (US)
Can I pay by card? / in cash?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: to‘lov. Ovqatdan so‘ng hisobni so‘rash uchun Britaniyada “Could we have the bill, please?” deyiladi. Amerikada esa “the check”. Ko‘pincha shunchaki “The bill, please” deyish ham yetarli. To‘lov usuli: “Can I pay by card?” — karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? “In cash” — naqd. Hisobda xizmat haqi bor-yo‘qligini bilish uchun: “Is service included?”
scenes.say: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please? Can I pay by card? Is service included?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, hisobni bersangiz? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Xizmat haqi qo‘shilganmi?

scenes.title: Bo‘lishib to‘lash va mehmon qilish
board: Can we pay separately? — Alohida to‘lasak bo‘ladimi?
Let's split the bill. — Teng bo‘lishamiz.
Keep the change. — Qaytimi kerak emas.
scenes.say_native: Do‘stlar bilan bo‘lsangiz, kim qancha to‘lashini kelishib olish kerak. “Can we pay separately?” — har kim o‘zinikini to‘laydi. “Let’s split the bill” — hisobni teng bo‘lamiz. Agar siz mehmon qilmoqchi bo‘lsangiz: “It’s on me” yoki “My treat” — men to‘layman. Naqd to‘lab, qaytimni ofitsiantga qoldirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz: “Keep the change”.
scenes.say: Let's split the bill. No, no, it's on me tonight. Thank you! Here you are. Keep the change.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobni bo‘lishaylik. Yo‘q, yo‘q, bugun men to‘layman. Rahmat! Mana, oling. Qaytimi kerak emas.

scenes.title: Choychaqa odatlari
board: UK: often 10–12.5% service charge on the bill
scenes.say_native: Choychaqa inglizcha “tip” deyiladi, xizmat haqi esa “service charge”. Britaniyada ko‘p restoranlar hisobga 12,5 foiz atrofida xizmat haqini o‘zi qo‘shadi. Agar qo‘shilmagan bo‘lsa, odatda taxminan 10 foiz qoldiriladi. Amerikada esa ofitsiantning maoshi kam, shuning uchun 15–20 foiz choychaqa kutiladi va uni qoldirmaslik juda noodob hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: In the UK, service is often included. In the US, people usually leave a tip of fifteen to twenty per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniyada xizmat haqi ko‘pincha qo‘shilgan bo‘ladi. Amerikada odatda o‘n besh-yigirma foiz choychaqa qoldirishadi.

scenes.title: Hisob so‘rashdagi xatolar
board: ✓ The bill, please. (UK) / The check, please. (US)
✗ How much it costs?  ✓ How much is it?
scenes.say_native: Rus tilidagi “schyot” so‘zini ba’zilar “count” deb tarjima qiladi. Lekin “count” sanash degani, restoranda bu so‘z ishlatilmaydi. To‘g‘risi: “the bill” yoki Amerikada “the check”. Ikkinchi xato — savol tartibi: “How much it costs?” Inglizcha savolda yordamchi fe’l kerak: “How much is it?” yoki “How much does it cost?”
scenes.say: The bill, please. How much is it? How much does it cost?
scenes.say_uz: Hisobni bering, iltimos. Bu qancha? Bu qancha turadi?

scenes.title: Nima deysiz?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vaziyat, har biri uchun bitta ibora ayting. Birinchi: Londondagi restoranda hisobni so‘rang. Ikkinchi: karta bilan to‘lash mumkinmi, deb so‘rang. Uchinchi: do‘stingizga hisobni teng bo‘lishni taklif qiling. To‘rtinchi: ofitsiantga qaytimni olib qolishini ayting.
scenes.say: Ask for the bill. Ask about the card. Split the bill. Leave the change.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobni so‘rang. Karta haqida so‘rang. Hisobni bo‘lishing. Qaytimni qoldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Could we have the bill, please?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Could we have the bill, please?” Londonda “check” emas, “bill” deyiladi. Ikkinchi: “Can I pay by card?” Uchinchi: “Let’s split the bill.” To‘rtinchi: “Keep the change.” Agar ikkinchisida “Can I pay with a card?” degan bo‘lsangiz, bu ham to‘g‘ri, ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi. Hammasini bir marta ketma-ket baland ovozda takrorlang.
scenes.say: Could we have the bill, please? Can I pay by card? Let's split the bill. Keep the change.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobni bersangiz? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Hisobni bo‘lishaylik. Qaytimi kerak emas.

scenes.title: Dialog 3: to‘lov
board: How much tip do they leave?
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi, oxirgi dialog. Ikki do‘st Londondagi kafeda ovqatlanib bo‘ldi va hisobni so‘rayapti. Tinglang: ular qanday to‘laydi, xizmat haqi qo‘shilganmi va qancha choychaqa qoldirishadi? Bugungi so‘zlardan qaysilarini eshitganingizni ham sanab boring: “the bill”, “split”, “separately”, “by card”.
scenes.say: Anna: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please? Waiter: Of course. Here you are. Tom: Thanks. Is service included? Waiter: No, it isn't. Anna: Let's split the bill. Tom: OK. Can we pay separately, by card? Waiter: Yes, no problem. Anna: The food was lovely. Let's leave ten per cent. Tom: Good idea.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Kechirasiz, hisobni bersangiz? Ofitsiant: Albatta. Mana. Tom: Rahmat. Xizmat haqi qo‘shilganmi? Ofitsiant: Yo‘q, qo‘shilmagan. Anna: Hisobni bo‘lishaylik. Tom: Mayli. Alohida, karta bilan to‘lasak bo‘ladimi? Ofitsiant: Ha, muammo yo‘q. Anna: Taom juda yoqimli edi. O‘n foiz qoldiraylik. Tom: Yaxshi fikr.

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 3) How much tip do they leave?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Xizmat haqi hisobga qo‘shilganmi? Ular qanday to‘laydi: naqdmi yoki karta bilan, birgami yoki alohida? Qancha choychaqa qoldirishadi? Ingliz tilida qisqa javob bering. Masalan, birinchi savolga “Yes, it is” yoki “No, it isn’t” deb javob berish mumkin.
scenes.say: Is service included? How do they pay? How much tip do they leave?
scenes.say_uz: Xizmat haqi qo‘shilganmi? Ular qanday to‘laydi? Qancha choychaqa qoldirishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yo‘q, xizmat haqi qo‘shilmagan: “No, it isn’t”. Ikkinchi: ular alohida, karta bilan to‘laydi: “separately, by card”. Uchinchi: o‘n foiz: “ten per cent”. Bu Britaniya uchun odatiy miqdor. E’tibor bering, Britaniyada “per cent” ikki so‘z bilan, Amerikada esa ko‘pincha “percent” bitta so‘z bilan yoziladi.
scenes.say: No, service isn't included. They pay separately, by card. They leave ten per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q, xizmat haqi qo‘shilmagan. Ular alohida, karta bilan to‘laydi. O‘n foiz qoldirishadi.

scenes.title: Rolli o‘yin: siz mijozsiz
board: Waiter: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
Waiter: Is everything OK with your meal?
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy topshiriq. Men ofitsiantman, siz mijozsiz. Ofitsiant to‘rtta savol beradi. Har biridan keyin to‘liq javob bering: joy band qilganingizni ayting, boshlang‘ich va asosiy taom buyurtma qiling, bitta muloyim shikoyat qiling va oxirida hisobni so‘rang. Bugun o‘rgangan hamma narsani ishlating.
scenes.say: Good evening. Do you have a reservation? Are you ready to order? Is everything OK with your meal? Anything else?
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kech. Joy band qilganmisiz? Buyurtma berasizmi? Taomingiz bilan hammasi joyidami? Yana biror narsa?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Yes, I've booked a table for two.
For my starter, I'd like ... For my main course, I'll have ...
I'm afraid my ... is a bit cold.
scenes.say_native: Mana namunaviy javob. “Yes, I’ve booked a table for two at eight.” “For my starter, I’d like the lentil soup, and for my main course, I’ll have the grilled chicken without sauce.” “I’m sorry, but I’m afraid my chicken is a bit cold. Could you warm it up, please?” “No, thank you. Just the bill, please. Can I pay by card?”
scenes.say: Yes, I've booked a table for two at eight. For my starter, I'd like the lentil soup. For my main course, I'll have the grilled chicken. I'm afraid it's a bit cold. Could you warm it up? Just the bill, please.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, soat sakkizga ikki kishilik stol band qilganman. Boshlang‘ich taomga yasmiq sho‘rvasini olaman. Asosiy taomga panjarada pishgan tovuqni olaman. Afsuski, u biroz sovuq. Isitib bersangiz? Faqat hisobni bering, iltimos.

scenes.title: Bugun nimalarni o‘rgandik
board: Menu: starter, main course, dessert; fried, boiled, grilled
Order: I'd like / I'll have / Could I have ... without ...?
Complain: Excuse me + I'm afraid + Could you ...?
Pay: the bill (UK) / the check (US), tip, split
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: menyu qismlari va pishirish usullari, taom nomida “-ed” shakli: “fried”, “boiled”, “grilled”. Ikkinchi: buyurtma uchun “I’d like”, “I’ll have”, “Could I have”, maxsus iltimoslar uchun “without”, “on the side”, “I’m allergic to”. Uchinchi: shikoyat uch qismdan iborat va yumshatuvchi so‘zlar bilan aytiladi.
scenes.say: Starter, main course, dessert. I'd like the soup, please. I'm afraid it's a bit cold. Could we have the bill, please?
scenes.say_uz: Boshlang‘ich taom, asosiy taom, shirinlik. Sho‘rvani olmoqchiman, iltimos. Afsuski, u biroz sovuq. Hisobni bersangiz?

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Check: no “Give me”, use “I'm afraid”, “the bill”
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Restorandagi to‘liq tashrifni rolli o‘yin qilib bajaring: oila a’zosi yoki do‘stingiz ofitsiant bo‘lsin, yoki ikkala rolni o‘zingiz yozing. Unda kirish, boshlang‘ich va asosiy taom buyurtmasi, bitta maxsus iltimos, bitta muloyim shikoyat va to‘lov bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Enjoy your meal, and see you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Yoqimli ishtaha va keyingi safargacha!

homework_uz: Restorandagi to‘liq tashrifni rolli o‘yin qilib bajaring yoki yozing: kirish, boshlang‘ich va asosiy taom buyurtmasi, bitta maxsus iltimos, bitta muloyim shikoyat va to‘lov. Mezon: kamida 12 qator, “Give me” yo‘q, shikoyatda “I’m afraid” yoki “a bit” bor, oxirida “the bill” ishlatilgan.

quiz.q: Which part of the menu comes first?
quiz.why_uz: Starter — asosiy taomdan oldingi yengil taom.
Taomni tasvirlashda -ed shakli ishlatiladi: fried chicken.

quiz.q: What is the most polite way to order?
options: Could I have the soup, please?
quiz.why_uz: Could I have ..., please? — muloyim buyurtma. Give me qo‘pol eshitiladi.
Sifat allergic + predlog to: I'm allergic to nuts.

quiz.q: “Can I have the sauce ___ the side?”
Your soup is cold. What do you say?
options: This soup is bad! Change it!
Excuse me, I'm afraid my soup is a bit cold.
quiz.why_uz: Muloyim shikoyat: Excuse me + I'm afraid + a bit.

quiz.q: In a London restaurant you ask for ___.
quiz.why_uz: Britaniyada the bill, Amerikada the check deyiladi.

quiz.q: You want to pay for your friend. You say:
quiz.why_uz: It's on me — men to‘layman, mehmon qilaman.

quiz.q: In the USA, a tip of about ___ is usual in restaurants.
